builtBy: Research by hand, 2026-11-13, for the girls volleyball build: commitment lists (Prep Dig, PrepVolleyball, SportsRecruits' commits feed for program ids 6 to 453), 292 college athletics sites' news feeds from 2026-11-11 on, school and local papers, the clubs' commitment pages and the players' own recruiting pages. Every quote was checked against its page as served that day, twice.
notes: Players on the 41 tracked varsity rosters a public page says have committed to, or signed with, a college team, in volleyball or any other sport. The rules are field hockey's (README, "College commitments"): the page names the player, the college and the sport, and either names her high school or gives the roster's class year with a hometown in the school's own area; offers, interests, visits and camps are not commitments; a social-media post counts only from an official college, school or club account (none is cited here).

Five commitments, four in volleyball and one in beach volleyball. Maura Hambly's is signed: Cal's own release of 2026-11-11 names her with Palo Alto High School. Aanya Hotha's (Penn), Kylee Mark's (Cal Poly) and Katie Hamburger's (Tulane, beach) rest on their schools' student papers, with Prep Dig or PrepVolleyball agreeing for the first two; neither Penn nor Cal Poly had posted a signing release by 2026-11-13, and Tulane's beach release of 2026-11-12 names five other signees, so those three stay committed. Emi Yu-Yang's (Hamilton) is medium: her own SportsRecruits page gives the class year, Palo Alto and the commitment but no school.

Recall is partial. The fall signing period opened two days before the search, and many colleges had posted nothing. SportsRecruits' commits feed was read for 434 of about 3,700 programs. Only 15 of the 41 schools' student papers were found. Name-by-name web searches covered about a third of the seniors and juniors before the session's search allowance ran out; the rest were searched on the school and local papers' own sites and on Prep Dig.
Tulane's beach volleyball conference is left blank: the schedule page read on 2026-11-13 was an earlier season's.

commitments.basis: El Estoque ('The Student News Site of Monta Vista High School'), 2025-09-06: its subheading and photo caption call it her Cal Poly SLO commitment; the body tells of the offer and quotes her 'I was pretty set on committing right away'. A junior in September 2025 is the class of 2027. Prep Dig independently lists her as committed: its California commitments list (High School: Monta Vista, class 2027) and its Monta Vista team roster (Monta Vista, Cupertino, CA) both carry a college logo link titled 'Cal Poly-San Luis Obispo' (https://prepdig.com/college/cal-poly-san-luis-obispo/), and her player page's recruiting table reads 'Cal Poly-San Luis Obispo Committed'. The news sub-sweep read the El Estoque body alone as an offer and would have left her out; the headline, the caption and Prep Dig settle it. Cal Poly's volleyball page listed no signing release as of 2026-11-13, so the status stays 'committed'. Prep Dig's 2/6/26 is an entry date and is not used.

sources.quote: Watch Emi's recruiting video • 2027 • Setter, Defensive Specialist • Marin Volleyball Club • Palo Alto, CA • Committed to Hamilton College

commitments.basis: Rule (b): her own SportsRecruits volleyball profile's description (in the page's served HTML meta tags, not drawn by script; fetched twice on 2026-11-13, both reads identical) gives the class of 2027, the roster's class, and the hometown Palo Alto, CA, the school's city, with 'Committed to Hamilton College'. The roster lists her as a setter, as the profile does. SportsRecruits' commits feed lists 'Emi Yu-Yang, 2027, Volleyball' under program id 183. No page naming Palo Alto High School was found, so medium. Her Hudl profile, which is on Palo Alto High School's own volleyball team, lists the same club, Marin Volleyball Club, for 2026 (data/volleyball/clubs.json), so the SportsRecruits page's club agrees with a page that names her school; the commitment itself still rests on the one page.

commitments.basis: Cal's own signing release of 2026-11-11 (headline 'Cal Volleyball Officially Signs Nationally Ranked Class', 'inking a four-player class') names Maura Hambly, outside hitter, with 'Palo Alto High School/Vision Volleyball Club'. Viking Magazine (Palo Alto High's sports magazine, 2025-10-21) reports the commitment and the class of 2027. Prep Dig's player page, its California commitments list and its Palo Alto team roster (Palo Alto, CA) show the same college; on the list and roster the college is a logo link titled 'California' (https://prepdig.com/college/california/). Prep Dig's list date (4/14/26) and its player page's 'Committed on 07/10/2025' are entry dates and are not used. The release gives her hometown as Stanford, CA.

sources.quote: After being scouted by many schools, the junior committed on March 16 to continue her athletic and academic journey in Pennsylvania.
sources.statedSchool: Saratoga High School (The Saratoga Falcon is its student newspaper)

commitments.basis: The Saratoga Falcon, Saratoga High's student newspaper (its footer: 'the student journalists of Saratoga High School'), reported on 2026-05-20 that junior Aanya Hotha committed on March 16 to play volleyball at Penn ('will play middle for the Quakers'); a junior in May 2026 is the class of 2027, the roster's class. PrepVolleyball lists 'Aanya Hotha | 2027 MB | Vision' among the players featured in its commitment update of April 1, 2026 (the article body is for subscribers and the college is not shown), which agrees on class year, position and timing. Penn's site had no signing release as of 2026-11-13 (the Ivy League does not use the National Letter of Intent).
